steps.what: Plan health programs and standards around clinical needs and resources
Arrange programme activities, responsibilities and review dates
Implement the health programme and assess its clinical operation

tasks.design: Use native {PROJECT} task templates and {CALENDAR} invitations for arrangements from a physician-approved health programme plan. Keep clinical programme design, implementation and outcome judgement with the physician and programme team.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dates and responsibilities are repeatedly copied into coordination messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed task and invitation templates can reuse an agreed plan.
tasks.still_hard: A programme must fit the population, clinical needs and available delivery capacity.
tasks.human_edge: Choose an appropriate intervention and recognise when delivery needs clinical adjustment.
tasks.altitude: Less arrangement correspondence; programme responsibility is unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate delivery resources for prevention programmes

evidence.claim: Native task and invitation configuration can reduce repeated coordination; the proposed health-programme saving is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes this physician's programme planning, arrangements and implementation, excluding other team members' delivery labour and patient care assigned to separate tasks.

The physician produces activity, owner, date, duration, location and resource constraints in s1 and retained s2 time; all 40 planning hours and eight coordination hours remain. Existing participant and resource calendars supply availability; no new upstream data-entry duty is required.
Unknown capacity or disputed responsibilities return to manual coordination within retained s2 time. Test native project and calendar templates before custom code.
unknowns: Actual programme remit and current coordination time
research_questions: Can agreed programme arrangements be reused without increasing field capture or team coordination effort?

already_counted.description: Plan preparation and arrangement capture, exceptions and confirmation

incremental.description: Maintain programme task templates and booking rules

approvals.approved_version: Exact activities, owners, dates, locations, recipients and resource assumptions; changes require renewed confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+8+40=88; gross 12%, minus three upkeep gives 9% central net. Low assumes only five correspondence hours removable; clinical design and implementation remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train residents, students and health professionals

steps.what: Train residents, medical students and professionals through supervised clinical teaching

tasks.design: Keep supervised clinical training and feedback with the physician. Existing references in {DOCS} support teaching; no automated supervisor or new teaching-material production task is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training depends on the trainee's actual clinical reasoning and behaviour.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical references already support the human teaching interaction.
tasks.still_hard: A trainee can state the correct rule while applying it incorrectly with a patient.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the reasoning, correct practice and protect the patient while the trainee learns.
tasks.altitude: Clinical teaching responsibility and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Direct supervised clinical training retains all labour; no unobserved preparation baseline is assigned to it.

assumptions: Boundary is the physician's direct supervision, explanation and feedback, excluding trainee labour and separately commissioned teaching materials.
No new structured trainee score or automated educational decision is introduced.
Existing native reference access suffices. No deployment or ongoing maintenance is added, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Trainee stage and local supervision requirements
research_questions: Which trainee activities require direct rather than indirect supervision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Direct clinical teaching remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare government and organisational medical reports

steps.what: Gather authorised clinical and workforce information for the requested report
Prepare statistics and explanatory text for the report

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory text for verified tables and clinician-selected facts
loop.input: Verified dataset, fixed statistical tables and report specification
loop.output: Draft report linking each factual sentence to a table or source fact
loop.check: Physician checks population, period, denominators, clinical meaning, privacy and whether every explanation is supported rather than inferred
loop.stop: One revision then manual drafting if meaning or source support is uncertain
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed calculations and templates handle tables; varied clinical explanations require semantic drafting

steps.what: Verify the report's clinical meaning and authorise its release

tasks.design: Configure authorised exports from {OTHER}, the clinical record system, and {HCM}, then calculate defined statistics deterministically. A bounded {DOCS} draft may explain verified tables or selected clinical facts; the physician checks the exact report before release through the existing reporting process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source retrieval, repeated calculations and rewriting factual report sections take time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and fixed definitions can assemble tables while a bounded draft handles explanatory wording.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical status reports and population statistics have different disclosure and interpretation requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what a report can responsibly say and what information is appropriate for its recipient.
tasks.altitude: Less retrieval and drafting; report authorisation remains with the physician.

reach.task: Validate reporting definitions and recipient requirements
reach.learn: Denominators, reporting periods and disclosure limits

evidence.claim: Fixed export mappings and physician-reviewed explanatory reports are an E1 design; the digest's consultation scribes do not establish statutory-report accuracy.

assumptions: Boundary is physician retrieval, report preparation and authorisation, excluding original clinical-record creation, workforce evaluation decisions and external submission by the reporting officer.

Clinical staff produce existing patient IDs, event dates, diagnoses and recorded status in the source record; the people team produces workforce IDs, period and authorised evaluation fields in its existing process. No new coding or clinical evaluation is assumed upstream.

The physician selects cohort, reporting period, purpose, permitted fields and recipient, checks source completeness and manually captures non-exportable facts within 20 retained s1 hours. Missing or inconsistent fields require manual retrieval there; do not launch if the allowance is insufficient.

Reporting definitions supplied by the reporting officer determine each denominator and category; new maintenance is counted below. Test native report templates and exports first. Source observations and original record capture are not saved again.
unknowns: Exact report types, required definitions and permissions
Source completeness and native export coverage
research_questions: Can a parallel report reconcile every population count and clinical statement while reducing retrieval and drafting time?

already_counted.description: Report specification capture, dataset checks, draft correction and final authorisation

incremental.description: Maintain report guidance and investigate recurring data exceptions
Maintain source mappings, definitions and access

approvals.approved_version: Exact report text and tables, population, period, source versions, disclosure scope and recipient; changes void authorisation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+15+30=65; gross 35%, minus four focal upkeep gives 31% central net. Low assumes only ten retrieval and drafting hours removable when sources need substantial manual interpretation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce programme correspondence and report preparation while retaining clinical programme choices, training and final report judgement.
reach: Work with reporting officers on source definitions and disclosure requirements
role.ambitious_version: A physician who spends less time assembling reports and more time on clinical judgement and teaching.
